segments.name: Equity investments
segments.description: Makes equity investments in rapidly growing venture capital-backed emerging companies, seeking capital gains.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Earns returns from the portfolio companies it invests in: mainly capital gains on equity investments, and to a lesser extent income from debt investments.
revenueModel.evidence: Our investment objective is to maximize our portfolio's total return, principally by seeking capital gains on our equity and equity-related investments, and to a lesser extent, income from debt investments.
